title: 5 Years Later, Netflix Is Finally Bringing Beloved Shonen Jump Film
content: In December last year, fans bid a bittersweet farewell to My Hero Academia ‘s anime nine years after its debut. It took the anime series a little more than a year after the manga finale to wrap up the story following the aftermath of the Final War.

title: I Made Friends With the Second Prettiest Girl in My Class Anime Reveals 3rd Promo Video, More Cast Members
content: ASMIK Ace revealed the third promotional video and new cast members for the television anime adaptation of Takata 's I Made Friends with the Second Prettiest Girl in My Class ( Class de 2-ban Me ni Kawaii Onna no Ko to Tomodachi ni Natta ) light novel series on Tuesday.
author: ANN

title: 37 Years Later, Studio Ghibli Producer Resolves a Beloved Fantasy’s Biggest Mystery
content: Studio Ghibli is known for many iconic and beloved anime films, most of which have been directed by Hayao Miyazaki. He is one of the most celebrated directors in Japanese history, praised for taking his films to a global audience.

title: Spy x Family Teases Loid’s Secret Finally Being Exposed in Latest Arc
content: Warning: This article contains spoilers from the Spy x Family manga! The beloved spy action series, Spy x Family , wrapped up its exciting Season 3 in December last year, as fans still await updates on a sequel season.

title: Sword Art Online's Echoes of Aincrad Game Previews 'Unanswered//butterfly' Bonus Anime
content: Bandai Namco Entertainment began streaming a new trailer for Echoes of Aincrad , the new action RPG based on Reki Kawahara 's Sword Art Online franchise, on Monday. The trailer previews the game's bundled "Unanswered//butterfly" bonus special promotional anime.
author: ANN

title: Eren the Southpaw Anime Casts Natsumi Fujiwara
content: The staff for the television anime of Kappi and nifuni 's Hidarikiki no Eren ( Eren the Southpaw ) manga announced on Monday that Natsumi Fujiwara plays Akari Kishi's manager Sachiyo Saitō. Saitō appears in episode 6 of the series, which airs on Tuesday.
author: ANN
